Having successfully completed this course, students will be able to:

- Explain how large language models work and why they fail (hallucination, sycophancy, limited context).
- Direct an AI agent to build real products in domains they haven't learned before.
- Use Git, GitHub, and pull requests fluently as everyday version control and collaboration tools.
- Verify agent-built systems with tests, review agents, and continuous integration with GitHub Actions, and deploy to the web with GitHub Pages.
- Analyze data with an agent using Python, and check the numbers, not just the plots.
- Call LLMs from their own code, and connect agents to tools using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Orchestrate multiple agents and collaborate with teammates on a shared codebase.
- Use AI responsibly: verify outputs, disclose AI use, and protect secrets and personal data.
- Teach themselves a new domain using an agent — the meta-skill that outlasts any single tool.
